mapper.select: SELECT id, title, exam_date AS examDate FROM exam_info WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND publish_status = 1 ORDER BY exam_date DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM exam_info WHERE id = #{examId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM exam_info WHERE id = #{examId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id AS targetId, COALESCE(view_count, 0) AS count FROM exam_info WHERE id IN
#{id}

SELECT organizer, location, audience_scope, audience_summary, contact_name, contact_phone, registration_mode, participant_mode, capacity, capacity_unit, cover_attachment_id, cancelled_at, cancel_reason, publish_status, start_precision, end_precision, time_description, registration_start_precision, registration_end_precision, start_time, end_time, summary, event_type, edition_label, id, user_id, title, category, content, registration_start, registration_end, exam_date, exam_date_end, official_url, status, audit_status, reject_reason, is_pinned, comment_count, like_count, view_count, published_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM exam_info WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_info SET title = #{event.title}, summary = #{event.summary}, category = #{event.category}, event_type = #{event.eventType}, edition_label = #{event.editionLabel}, organizer = #{event.organizer}, location = #{event.location}, audience_scope = #{event.audienceScope}, audience_summary = #{event.audienceSummary}, contact_name = #{event.contactName}, contact_phone = #{event.contactPhone}, registration_mode = #{event.registrationMode}, participant_mode = #{event.participantMode}, capacity = #{event.capacity}, capacity_unit = #{event.capacityUnit}, cover_attachment_id = #{event.coverAttachmentId}, time_description = #{event.timeDescription}, content = #{event.content}, start_time = #{event.startTime}, end_time = #{event.endTime}, start_precision = #{event.startPrecision}, end_precision = #{event.endPrecision}, registration_start = #{event.registrationStart}, registration_end = #{event.registrationEnd}, registration_start_precision = #{event.registrationStartPrecision}, registration_end_precision = #{event.registrationEndPrecision}, exam_date = #{event.examDate}, exam_date_end = #{event.examDateEnd} WHERE id = #{event.id} AND publish_status IN (0, 1, 2) AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE exam_info SET publish_status = 1, status = 2, audit_status = 0, reject_reason = NULL, published_at = COALESCE(published_at, NOW()) WHERE id = #{id} AND publish_status IN (0, 2) AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE exam_info SET publish_status = 2, status = 0, is_pinned = FALSE WHERE id = #{id} AND publish_status = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE exam_info SET deleted_at = NOW(), status = 6, publish_status = 2, is_pinned = FALSE WHERE id = #{id} AND publish_status IN (0, 2, 3) AND deleted_at IS NULL
